data.name: Metric_Download_Help
data.value: Saurin saukarwa: yadda bayanai ke isa wannan PC daga intanet da sauri, ana auna shi ta saukar da bayanan gwaji na dakika 8. Mafi girma ya fi kyau; yawo bidiyo yana buƙatar kusan 5 zuwa 25 Mbps.

data.name: Metric_Upload_Help
data.value: Saurin lodawa: yadda wannan PC ke aika bayanai zuwa intanet da sauri, ana auna shi na dakika 8. Mafi girma ya fi kyau; kiran bidiyo da madadin girgije suna dogara da shi.

data.name: Metric_Latency_Help
data.value: Jinkiri: lokacin da saƙo yake ɗauka don isa uwar garken intanet ya dawo, a millisecond. Ƙasa ya fi kyau; ƙasa da 50 ms yana ji nan take a wasanni da kira. “Lokacin nauyi” yana nuna shi yayin saukarwa da lodawa.

data.name: Metric_Variation_Help
data.value: Sauyi (jitter): yadda jinkiri ke canzawa daga wannan lokaci zuwa na gaba. Ƙasa ya fi kyau; sama da 30 ms, kira da wasanni suna fara yankewa.

data.name: Chart_Help
data.value: Kowane sanda gwaji ɗaya ne; tsayinsa shi ne jinkiri a millisecond (ma’auni a hagu, lokaci a ƙasa). Ƙasa ya fi kyau. Sanduna a launin “Sama da iyakarka” sun wuce iyakarka, kuma sanduna masu layi-layi ba su sami amsa ba. Nuna sanda don ganin ƙimarsa.

data.name: Lane_Local_Help
data.value: Hanyar sadarwa ta gida: lokacin da router ɗinka yake ɗauka don amsa wannan PC. Yana nuna matsaloli da Wi-Fi ko kebul a cikin gidanka.

data.name: Lane_Internet_Help
data.value: Intanet: lokacin da yake ɗauka don haɗawa da uwar garke a intanet. Yana nuna matsaloli da mai ba ka intanet.

data.name: Lane_Services_Help
data.value: Ayyukan yanar gizo: lokacin da yake ɗauka don nemo adireshin yanar gizo da loda shafin yanar gizo. Yana nuna jinkirin neman suna ko shafukan yanar gizo.

data.name: Symptom_Gaming_Help
data.value: Zaɓi wannan idan wasanni suna jinkiri, daskarewa ko rubber-band. Shawara sai ta mayar da hankali kan jinkiri, sauyi da kwanciyar hankali.

data.name: Symptom_Video_Help
data.value: Zaɓi wannan idan bidiyo suna tsayawa don buffering ko ingancinsu yana raguwa. Shawara sai ta mayar da hankali kan saurin saukarwa da neman suna.

data.name: Symptom_Calls_Help
data.value: Zaɓi wannan idan kiran murya ko bidiyo suna yankewa ko daskarewa. Shawara sai ta mayar da hankali kan jinkiri, sauyi da saurin lodawa.

data.name: Symptom_Disconnects_Help
data.value: Zaɓi wannan idan haɗin yana katsewa gaba ɗaya lokaci-lokaci. Shawara sai ta mayar da hankali kan siginar Wi-Fi, adana wuta da adapters.
